title: Node
description: One fold. Field order is fold.ts's key order; absent fields are left out, as `JSON.stringify` leaves out `undefined`.

act.description: fold.ts `act`: the fold's one action, `{cap, call, args, label}`, shown as an HTML form (ax.rs `act_form`).

acts.description:
The fold's other acts (S2, allie-s2-fold-act-write §7 step 0: a Needs-you item's ack, defer and decline), each `{id?, cap,
call, args, label}` as `act` is, plus its own `id` where it names one. fold-core's own field (not fold.ts's): an act's own id
(ax.rs `act_key`) is its `id`, else its `cap`, so reordering an item's acts moves no act's id.

Kid.description: A link on a fold: one row.

Step.description: The fold before or after one in a presenting subtree's reading order.
